question: In which part of the female reproductive system is the egg fertilised by sperm?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fallopian tube**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Fallopian tube is a part of the female reproductive system, and it is the site where fertilization of the egg (ovum) by the sperm typically occurs.
 
• The process of fertilization usually happens in the ampulla, which is the widest section of the Fallopian tube.
 
• The Fallopian tubes play a crucial role in the female reproductive process by transporting the egg from the ovary to the uterus.
